info.name: SonarQube Cloud Web authentication webhooks API
Create a Webhook. Requires 'Administer' permission on the specified project.

params.name: name
params.description: Name displayed in the administration console of webhooks

params.name: organization
params.description: The key of the organization that will own the webhook

params.name: project
params.description: The key of the project that will own the webhook

params.name: secret
params.description: If provided, secret will be used as the key to generate the HMAC hex (lowercase) digest value in the 'X-Sonar-Webhook-HMAC-SHA256' header

params.name: url
params.description: Server endpoint that will receive the webhook payload, for example 'http://my_server/foo'. If HTTP Basic authentication is used, HTTPS is recommended to avoid man in the middle attacks. Example: 'https://myLogin:myPassword@my_server/foo'

items.docs: Create a Webhook. Requires 'Administer' permission on the specified project.

info.name: Delete a Webhook. Requires 'Administer' permission on the specified project, or global 'Administer' permission.

params.name: webhook
params.description: The key of the webhook to be deleted, auto-generated value can be obtained through api/webhooks/create or api/webhooks/list

info.name: Update a Webhook. Requires 'Administer' permission on the specified project, or global 'Administer' permission.

params.name: secret
params.description: If provided, secret will be used as the key to generate the HMAC hex (lowercase) digest value in the 'X-Sonar-Webhook-HMAC-SHA256' header. If blank, any secret previously configured will be removed. If not set, the secret will remain unchanged.
